method: Round one reviewed the full source/proof/Tensor/compiler/closure package. Round two reviewed only the correction, exact task-source and import-closure deltas, affected build receipts and complete frozen pins. Read-only verifier rerun; no Lean compilation, CPU/compiler experiment or GPU execution repeated by reviewer.

resolved_findings.resolution: Removed serialAbsent from the BF16 CompilerPlan and restored the inherited integer serialSource, denominatorSource and conditional serialRouting fields. CompilerPlan.ofOriginal projects every original BF16 CompilerBinding; compilerPlan_original_domain proves the new plan exists without a nativeSerial restriction. The source, numerical graph, successful-execution theorem body and Python admitted domain are unchanged.

positive_findings: Both readable Python/Lean bodies retain independent input/output strides, complete query/key loops and masks, boundary loads/stores and distinct FP16/BF16 QK precision paths.

Whole.runPrograms invokes FP.Structural.exec on Source.source for every current-memory CTA. Source decomposition, prologue/loop/epilogue success and whole-grid coverage/uniqueness derive successful execution without result or execution premises.

Independent arbitrary-Real softmax and state-free native recurrences connect to actual caller Tensor pointer/coordinate observations and finite storage. Native instruction ports are scalar/conversion or single fixed seeded m16n8k16 output coordinates, not whole reductions or result oracles.
RawFrame, observed exterior word frames, preserved input coordinates and complete read-allocation exterior are proved. Empty work gives identity source execution and unchanged caller words.

Actual create_function_from_signature and _pack_args binder profiles preserve dynamic i32 arguments, singleton constexpr values and requested warp/stage/fusion options. Saved TTIR confirms FP16 dot output versus BF16 FP32 dot plus narrowing and explicit storage additions, probability casts and FP32 PV.

Current build objects, standard-base axiom and non-circularity audit evidence, exact source import closure, preserved originals and saved compiler artifacts are fully pinned. Runtime/compiler/ISA boundaries are stated separately and no GPU/runtime success or universal compiler-conformance claim is made.
limits: Compiler/source/ISA correspondence and ordinary truthful Tensor API observations remain explicit implementation boundaries.
No GPU execution, universal compiler-conformance or native-to-Real accuracy claim.
